crossRefs.note: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me…
a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools…
Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with…
for our God is a consuming fire.
because it is written, “You shall be holy; for I am holy.”

translations.web: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’
translations.bsb: And you must not go up to My altar on steps, lest your nakedness be exposed on it.’
translations.kjv: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered
translations.asv: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not uncovered thereon.
